maya_csm: Flagging NovusCare - tokens/day down ~88% in last 10d. Renewal in 18 days. Champion left, procurement asked for a competitor proof-of-concept. Need urgent triage.

ops-bot: Alert: customer=NovusCare, metric=tokens_10d, change=-88%, seats=5->1, recent_deploy=2026-03-12. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/customers/novuscare/health

oliver_account: I'm on it. Reaching out to procurement now. Do we have immediate data on error types?

sam_eng: Quick check: recent error mix shows 60% 429, 25% 401, 15% 5xx. Top key last active 2026-03-13. Suspect partial key rotation + rate limits.

maya_csm: Procurement contact is Lina K. She said "calls timing out" and AtlasEdge offered a low-cost latency pilot yesterday. Lina wants written offer within 24h.

oliver_account: Proposed quick counter: 2-week dedicated throughput window (no contract), a 1-hour tech pairing, and an onboarding checklist. Can we approve as goodwill?

sam_eng: If it's key rotation + quota, we can whitelist their new key for a short window and bump per-key burst x3. Low-risk. Need the new key or client IP.

maya_csm: I'll ask Lina for a failing request id and the IP. Draft email: "Lina - we can enable a temporary dedicated window for 14 days and run a 1-hr pairing to stabilize. Can you share one failing request id and the client IP so we can whitelist? - Maya"

oliver_account: I'll send the commercial note and confirm dates after finance mirror approves credits > $3k. Tagging @finance.

ops-bot: Follow-up: after temporary quota bump and key reconciliation tokens/day recovered to ~70% baseline within 6h. Recommend schedule: 24h pairing, 48h monitor, 7-day QBR prep.

maya_csm: Call scheduled with Lina for tomorrow 10am PT. Assigning owners: outreach=oliver_account, tech=sam_eng, CS follow-up=maya_csm. Will update thread after call. :rocket:
